fields.reasoning: The orchestrator's real planner notes (~/orchestrator/planner-notes/*.md, 548 to 1997 bytes, numbered Markdown lists) are what a request should carry, so a note keeps its lines; a byte cap well above them keeps a pasted log out of every planner's brief
fields.statement: A request note is free text, possibly several lines (Markdown, as the orchestrator's planner-notes files are), stored on the request in requests.json (daemon.Request.Notes, oldest first) as given apart from trimming leading and trailing blank space and turning CRLF into LF; an empty note is refused, and a note over 8000 bytes or not valid UTF-8 is refused; rhiza request ls shows each request's notes (notes in --json, the count in text)
fields.wording: (assumed, would have escalated) the conductor's ruling, not asked of the owner
